Check whether the reported intervals are 90% intervals.
findings.question_for_authors: Are the reported confidence intervals 95% or 90% intervals?

findings.location: Abstract vs Results 'Comparison of the diagnostic performance of the 10-DM model and traditional biomarkers'
findings.evidence: Abstract: 'the 3-biomarker panel achieved a sensitivity of 0.925'. Results: on the 208 GC samples with biomarker records, any-of-3 positivity (CA19-9 >27, CA72-4 >6.9, CEA >5) is 89/208 = 0.428; the 0.925 value is the 10-DM sensitivity on the same 208 samples (195/208 = 0.938 in our recount of Biomarker_clinical.xlsx Sheet2 pred_score). The abstract sentence therefore attaches the model's sensitivity to the biomarker panel.
findings.question_for_authors: Does the abstract's 0.925 refer to the 3-biomarker panel or to the 10-DM model on the biomarker subset?
